items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: Simeon was a great fellow... Simeon played somewhat on Jimmy Noon's style. But they both, I guess they played together in the old ways.

ctx.x: Who were the other clarinets that impressed you around Chicago when you were here?
Oh, well Simeon, because Simeon died last year. Simeon was a great fellow, Donnell.
Simeon was pretty well developed when he came?
